name: claude-rastin
displayName: Rastin — Persian RTL for Claude Code and Codex
description: IranYekanX face and per-message RTL/LTR direction for Claude Code and Codex chats in VS Code. Code and tool rows stay LTR.

commands.title: Rastin: Repair after Claude Code or Codex update

rastin.enabled.description: Apply the Rastin font and direction rules to the Claude Code and Codex chats, and the direction rules to the Markdown preview and the Office Viewer Markdown editor.

enumDescriptions: Decide every paragraph by its first prose word.
Force the whole chat right-to-left; code and tool rows stay LTR.
Force the whole chat left-to-right; code and tool rows stay LTR.
rastin.direction.description: Direction for the Claude Code and Codex chats, the Markdown preview, and the Office Viewer. `auto` reads each paragraph; `rtl`/`ltr` override it for every message, panel, and the composer, while code blocks and tool rows keep LTR.

rastin.markdownPreview.description: Apply the direction rules to VS Code's built-in Markdown preview. Every paragraph, heading, list item, quote, and table cell is read on its own; code stays LTR.

rastin.officeViewer.description: Apply the direction rules to the Markdown editor of the Office Viewer extension (cweijan.vscode-office), in both WYSIWYG and IR modes. The editor reads the setting when it opens, so reopen the file after a change. Has no effect when that extension is not installed.

rastin.codex.description: Apply the Rastin font and direction rules to the Codex extension's chat (openai.chatgpt). Has no effect when Codex is not installed.

rastin.fontWeight.description: Prose weight for the Claude Code and Codex chats and composers. The bundle ships UltraLight, Light, Regular, and Bold; 500 and 600 are synthesized from Regular.

rastin.fontFamily.description: Font family for the Claude Code and Codex chat prose, e.g. "Vazirmatn". It must already be installed on this machine. The default is the bundled IranYekanX.

rastin.fontFile.description: Absolute path to a .woff2/.woff/.ttf/.otf file to use as the chat face, for fonts that are not installed. Copied into each patched chat's webview next to the bundled faces.

rastin.fontSize.description: Chat font size in px (8-32). 0 keeps the host's own size. Arrow keys move in 1px steps.

rastin.lineHeight.description: Line height for the Claude Code and Codex chat prose and composers. Arrow keys move in 0.1 steps.

rastin.codeFontFamily.description: Font family for code blocks and inline code. Leave empty to follow the VS Code editor font.

enumDescriptions: Use the colors of the current VS Code theme.
Claude's warm ivory/slate palette, following VS Code's light or dark mode.
Claude's warm ivory palette, even in a dark VS Code theme.
Claude's slate palette, even in a light VS Code theme.
rastin.theme.description: Color palette for the chat. High-contrast themes always keep the host colors.

scripts.prepare: git rev-parse --is-inside-work-tree >/dev/null 2>&1 && git config core.hooksPath .githooks || true
